actions.ranking_rule: grouped into this week / this month / with your advisor; inside a group: 2 x goal points + risk points + event points / 10 + 3 x urgency + 1 if you can do it alone

output.intro: Your goal: Build €250k of wealth by age 39, 1% chance today. The quick wins free €115 a month. Quick wins first, then one advisor conversation.

actions.title: Cancel what you no longer use (€15 a month)
actions.why: You pay €15 a month for Second cloud storage, which you no longer use. It protects you rather than clearly raising the goal chance. That is €1,800 freed over 10 years.
actions.how: Cancel Second cloud storage in the app's subscription view. The freed €15 a month moves into your savings automatically.

actions.title: Set a €280 monthly limit for eating out
actions.why: Eating out: €380 a month, people like you spend about €226. It protects you rather than clearly raising the goal chance. That is €12k freed over 10 years.
actions.how: Set a €280 limit in the app. You get a nudge at 80% of it, and whatever you do not spend under the limit moves into your savings.
actions.verified_by: Bank data: two months at or below the limit

actions.title: Write your will with the guided checklist
actions.why: €38k of savings and investments would pass on without a will. It protects you rather than clearly raising the goal chance.
actions.how: Answer the 12-question checklist in the app, then book a notary and upload the signed will.

actions.title: Agree a monthly investment plan of about €400
actions.why: You save €300 a month, 7% of income. Effect on your goal: +10 points. That is €48k saved over 10 years.
actions.how: Confirm the save-more-tomorrow commitment: half of your next raise goes into your monthly investment plan.
actions.verified_by: Bank data: the plan received its first payment

actions.title: Check your income protection
actions.why: You have no disability cover. It protects you rather than clearly raising the goal chance.
actions.how: Book the 15-minute income protection check with a specialist.
